name: Shift 2026-11-18 16:55 — ProjectManager report (empty runs explained: ownership, then the round cap)
description:
#TL; DR;

**Status: AT RISK — but both blockers are now measured, and both are smaller than the board claimed.**

- **Why agent runs produce nothing is settled.** An existing card cannot be given an owner (the tool rejects the argument). A card created *with* an owner keeps it — verified on two separate cards by reading the card back. A card with no owner returns a **blank reply**; an owned card does real work, minutes apart. Same engine.
- **The "missing tools" were never missing.** `qa_run_tests` (runs pytest) and `apply_file_changes` (edits large files) are in the registry — granted only to the QA profiles. So test execution and file patching were a **grant change measured in minutes**, not an engineer-day. What is genuinely missing is narrower: `git`/`tar` — i.e. snapshot, commit, untrack. Four cards depend on it.
- **Real work moved.** The degraded-search fallback (`GET /project/search` returning 200 instead of crashing) is already coded and tested. One box was unticked: the test was never executed. It now sits on an owner-carrying card that can run one command, dispatched this shift.
- **A new defect was found while checking my own work**, and it is the kind this board exists to catch: a card created without an explicit `status` stores an **empty string** — a card in none of the five canonical states, invisible to every status filter.

**One decision for management (D1, card `f8e10ad1`), re-costed from one engineer-day to mostly configuration, decide by 19 Nov 09:00Z. A second, narrower decision is a policy question: may an agent hold write access to git?**

---

## Done (with evidence)

### 1. Ownership → blank reply: reproduced in BOTH directions
| Card | `profiles` | Run outcome |
|---|---|---|
| `d8534b12` | `["software_developer"]` | 14 messages, analysis with `file:line` citations |
| `cdff59e2` | `["software_developer"]` | 15 messages, real source reads |
| `4a30693e` | `[]` | **blank assistant reply** (message_count 2→7) |
| `5608c889` (created 17:00:34Z) | `["qa_automation"]` | **persisted** — read back with `get_task` |
| `7937f9cb` (created 16:58:36Z) | `["ProjectManager"]` | **persisted** — read back with `get_task` |

Mechanism, both directions: `update_task(profiles=…)` alone → rejected ("Nothing to update: provide at least one of …" — `profiles` is not an accepted field). `profiles` sent *alongside* another field → silently dropped (`changed_fields: ["tags"]`, `"profiles": []`). Creation → kept. Option C is now a verified mechanism, not a proposal.

### 2. Second, separate blocker: the round cap truncates good runs
`cdff59e2` is owned, so the blank reply does not explain it: it ran to 15 messages and did genuine work — it established the loop-limit disagreement as `MAX = 40/8` in the constants vs `effort: 24/6` in the shipped profile. Then it stopped, after the read phase, before running a test or producing a patch. **Ownership explains a blank reply; the round cap explains a correct run that dies with no fix.** Card `73d89c91` promoted to `priority=high`, due 2026-11-19 (`changed_fields: [due_date, priority]`).

### 3. The capability gap is a GRANT gap
| Tool | In registry | Granted to |
|---|---|---|
| `qa_run_tests` | yes — really used by QA shift 4 (1442 collected, 110.5 s) | `qa`, `qa_automation`, `qa_explorer` |
| `apply_file_changes` | yes — hunk/patch editing | `qa_automation` |
| `project_write_file` | yes | `qa_automation` |
| git / tar / commit | **no** | — |

Two cards were wrong as written and are corrected: `76d97f04` ("no hunk/patch tool exists" → it exists, the grant is missing) and `e816cc41` (bundled pytest + patching + git → re-scoped to git/archive only).

### 4. A real deliverable is one command from done
`get_task 4a30693e` shows the engineering finished: `codx/junior/api/project_search.py` edited (try/except, WARNING log, 422 on blank query, 50-item bound, fallback to the existing `search_files()`), plus `tests/test_project_search_degraded.py` (5 functions / 6 items). That run had no `qa_run_tests`. Created **`5608c889`** with `profiles: ["qa_automation"]` carrying the exact call and an explicit warning that a bare `pytest:api` suite is a false green (`e5841226`). **Dispatched this shift** — the first end-to-end test of whether an owned `qa_automation` card executes.

### 5. New defect: a card can exist in no state
`create_task(...)` with `status` omitted persisted `"status": ""` on `5608c889` — rendered `-` in listings, matching none of `todo/doing/onhold/done/rejected`. Corrected to `todo` (`changed_fields: ["status"]`). Recorded on `a5f95606` as the second defect in the same field-handling path: **status** alone is accepted, omitted it stores an empty string; **profiles** alone is rejected, alongside another field it is silently dropped. Same call, four behaviours.

### 6. Writes, each verified by the tool response
| Card | Action | Verified result |
|---|---|---|
| `cdff59e2` | `request_help` | run outcome recorded; next owner told not to re-derive 40/8 vs 24/6 |
| `73d89c91` | `update_task` | `changed_fields: [due_date, priority]` |
| `76d97f04` | `request_help` | grant-vs-registry correction + how to prove it |
| `e816cc41` | `request_help` | re-scoped to git/tar, naming the 4 dependent cards |
| `5608c889` | `create_task` → `update_task` → `request_changes` | `profiles` persisted; `status: ""`→`todo`; run queued |
| `7937f9cb` | `request_help` | Option C proven twice; scope narrowed to non-dispatch-critical cards |
| `a5f95606` | `request_help` | second defect + combined acceptance criteria |

Board: **21 cards** on `IT team`. No card archived — `4a30693e` stays as the record of the code written until its clone pastes a pass line.

## Scheduled
- `5608c889` — the one-command test, `wake_at` 19 Nov 08:00Z (dispatched early; its wake is the fallback if the run is blank).
- `7937f9cb` — Option C sweep of the *remaining* cards, 19 Nov 08:00Z. Narrowed: only cards about to be dispatched, not a bulk re-create.
- Unchanged: `cdff59e2`/`d8534b12` 08:00Z · `f8e10ad1`/`76d97f04`/`9ce4e7ef` 09:00Z · `4a30693e`/`73d89c91` 09:05Z · `88d57bdd` 09:30Z · `a5f95606` 09:34Z · `e816cc41` 10:00Z.

## Decisions needed from management (by 19 Nov 09:00Z)
1. **D1, re-costed** (`f8e10ad1`): authorise the **profile tool-list change only** — pytest execution and file patching become available to the developer profiles, no engineer-day. Remaining real work: one narrow git/tar tool. **Recommendation: yes; do not fund an engineer-day for tools that already exist.**
2. **Policy, gating four cards** (`88d57bdd`, `9ce4e7ef`, `ab4072b9`, `39a2d6a4`): may an agent hold **write** access to git? **Recommendation: yes for snapshot/tar (a read-only copy of a dirty tree is safe and reversible); no for commit/push until a verified snapshot exists.** Not an engineering call — I will not take it myself.

## Blocked
- **D1 and the git policy are management's**; my default if unanswered is plan-only shifts, reported as a fact each time.
- **No commit made.** The dirty tree still mixes a CISO vault/secrets change with 30+ unrelated files and no snapshot exists.
- **Honest caveat:** that `5608c889` returns a pass line is under test right now. What is proven is that its owner profile persists; what is untested is that this profile is sufficient for the run. If the run comes back blank, **ownership is not the only cause** and that must be said plainly.
